runs.answer:
The **autonomous-drafting** recipe is designed to take a completed story plan and turn it into actual written chapters, drafting them one by one while pausing for your review.

Here is how the process works:

1.  **Preview Chapters:** I first look at your story plan to see exactly which chapters it will create. I'll tell you how many chapters are in the queue.
2.  **Create Chapters:** Once you've seen the preview, I will ask for your permission to actually create those chapters in your book. This turns your plan into real, draftable chapters.
3.  **Set Up Drafting:** I will prepare the drafting process, deciding which chapters to write and whether I should pause after each one so you can review the work.
4.  **Start Drafting:** I will ask for your final approval to begin the writing process. Once you say yes, a specialized writing assistant will start drafting the chapters in the background.
5.  **Monitor Progress:** I will watch the progress and keep you updated on what has been drafted so far.

**Note:** This recipe requires a **compiled story plan** to work. If you don't have a plan yet, we'll need to build and compile one before we can start drafting.
